Tai chinh.giai_thich: W3Schools: gia tri hien tai rong; rate la ty le chiet khau (VD 10%), value la cac dong tien.
Tai chinh.vi_du: =NPV(B9,B2:K2) voi rate 10% o B9, cashflow B2:K2 -> 377,87 cho 10 nam

Dem.giai_thich: W3Schools: chi dem o chua SO trong vung; o chu cai bi bo qua (dung COUNTA neu co chu).
Dem.vi_du: =COUNT(D2:D21) dem 20 o Total stats (so); =COUNT(A2:A21) tra 0 vi toan chu

Dem.giai_thich: W3Schools: dem moi o co gia tri (ca so va chu); o trong bi bo qua.
Dem.vi_du: =COUNTA(A2:A21) dem 20 ten Pokemon (chu); =COUNTA(D2:D21) dem ca vung so

Dem.giai_thich: W3Schools: dem o trong trong vung; huu ich tim du lieu thieu (VD thieu Type 2).
W3Schools: dem o theo 1 dieu kien (so hoac chu); khoa vung $ khi fill xuong.
Dem.vi_du: =COUNTIF($B$2:$B$21,F6) dem 6 Water, 1 Grass; khong khoa $ khi fill se lech vung

Dem.giai_thich: W3Schools: dem theo 1+ dieu kien AND (VD Type=Water VA Generation=1); dung absolute ref khi fill.
Dem.vi_du: =COUNTIFS(B2:B759,E3,C2:C759,F3) dem Water gen 1; mo rong nhieu cap range/criteria

Thong ke.giai_thich: W3Schools: do lech chuan TOAN BO tong the; bo qua o chu/logic; sigma do xa TB cua quan sat dien hinh.
Thong ke.vi_du: =STDEV.P(E2:E755) do lech chuan Total stats toan bo -> 113,4497844

Thong ke.giai_thich: W3Schools: do lech chuan MAU (sample); bo qua o chu/logic; dung STDEV.P neu co toan bo tong the.
Thong ke.vi_du: =STDEV.S(E2:E21) do lech chuan mau Total stats -> 113,2319

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: noi nhieu o/khoi ma KHONG tu them delimiter; tu chen delimiter (VD " ") giua cac o; thay CONCATENATE tu 2019, ho tro range.
Van ban.vi_du: =CONCAT(A2," ",A3) noi 2 o cach nhau bang space; ket hop text + so tuy y

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools (2019+/365): noi text voi delimiter chung 1 lan; TRUE bo o trong, FALSE giu (sinh delimiter doi); ket hop IF/FILTER de loc theo loai.
Van ban.vi_du: =TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,A5:A7) -> Charmander, Charmeleon, Charizard | =TEXTJOIN("/",TRUE,B2:C2) -> Grass/Poison; FALSE giu slash thua Fire/

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: lay N ky tu tu TRAI; num_chars >= 0, mac dinh 1; dung duoc cho 1 o hoac range.
Van ban.vi_du: =LEFT(A2) lay 1 ky tu dau (M cua Mankey) | =LEFT(A2,3) lay 3 ky tu | =LEFT(A2:A4,3) cho ca range

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: lay N ky tu tu PHAI; num_chars >= 0, mac dinh 1; dung duoc cho 1 o hoac range.
Van ban.vi_du: =RIGHT(A2) lay ky tu cuoi | =RIGHT(A2,3) lay 3 ky tu cuoi | =RIGHT(A2:A4,3) cho ca range

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: lay ky tu GIUA tu start_num (1-based) dai num_chars; vuot cuoi -> lay toi het, start vuot -> rong; luon tra TEXT (ghep VALUE/*1 de tinh).
Van ban.vi_du: =MID(B2,5,4) tu PKB-0200-BALL -> 0200 | =VALUE(MID(B2,5,4)) de SUM; ket hop =MID(A2,FIND("-",A2)+1,4)

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: dem so ky tu (chu, so, ky hieu, SPACE cung tinh); so dem theo chu so hien gia tri, khong theo format hien thi.
Van ban.vi_du: =LEN(A2) voi Poke Ball -> 9 (8 chu + 1 space); Paralyze Heal dai nhat 13; 1200 co LEN 4 du format $1,200.00

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: doi toan bo chu thanh chu thuong; dung chuan hoa du lieu lech case truoc khi xu ly case-sensitive.
Van ban.vi_du: =LOWER(A2) ManKey -> mankey | =LOWER(A2:B21) cho ca range 1 lan

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: doi toan bo chu thanh HOA; so/space/ky hieu giu nguyen; nguoc voi LOWER (viet hoa chu dau moi tu dung PROPER).
Van ban.vi_du: =UPPER(A2) pkb-0200-ball -> PKB-0200-BALL; fill =UPPER(A2:A9) chuan hoa ma hang

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: viet hoa chu dau MOI tu, cac chu con lai thuong; ky tu sau space/cham/gach/apostrophe/so deu bi coi la dau tu moi.
Van ban.vi_du: =PROPER(A2): ash ketchum -> Ash Ketchum, MISTY -> Misty, lt. surge -> Lt. Surge

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: xoa space thua dau/cuoi/giua, chi giu 1 space giua cac tu; dung duoc cho 1 o hoac range A2:C21.
Van ban.vi_du: =TRIM(A2) hoac =TRIM(A2:C21) don sach irregular spacing truoc khi so sanh/VLOOKUP

Van ban.giai_thich: W3Schools: thay the chu (phan biet HOA/thuong); bo instance -> thay het, co instance -> chi thay lan thu N.
Van ban.vi_du: =SUBSTITUTE(B2,"MEDS","HEAL") doi ma thuoc; =SUBSTITUTE(A2,"l","L",2) chi doi chu l thu 2
